title: feat(ridk9): ridge-slide same-k holds at k=9: t=21 vs t=31
science: rho3 at k=9 on B_27: t=21 vs 31, 1323>961. Its axis witness takes a DIFFERENT geodesic from the rest of the series (via (2,2,0) and a height-2 corridor: 3+3+1+1+7+3+3=21) yet lands on the same k+12 intercept, evidence that +12 is a property of the rule rather than of one chosen route.
